_note: Canonical palette for the Build & Brew kit. These hexes match the templates in templates/archetypes/ and AGENT.md exactly; if you change one, change all three.
rules: Ground is paper #f8f5f1 (never pure white) or leather #1b1918 (never pure black).

The default is none (fully tonal): the event photos are the hero. Ask every time and only add an accent when they want one; 'none' is always the right default. If they want a small pop, prefer emerald or a warm tonal highlight on type, never a big saturated block. One accent per post.

On a warm graded event photo, prefer a warm accent: pumpkin, canary, or sand. Cornflower and plum are cold and clash with the warm grade — keep them for cool or screenshot posts, not warm event photos. Emerald is the signature green: fine as a small highlight, never a block.
Plum stays out of large colour blocks.
Canary #ffdd2d is the yellow highlight accent.
